name: brain
description: Amnesia Labs internal alpha. Invite only.
changelog: v0.9.1 — vault + recall UX. Vault skill now relays the drop-link deadline in human terms (server default is 600s, up from 90s) and re-mints expired links immediately with ttl up to 1800s; corrected stale ~120s loa3 window claims to the server's 300s default. Brain skill gains a Known-gap bypass: when Brain provably can't have the answer (topic already recalled empty this session, inherently fresh/external info, or the user says so), search externally without blocking on recall — then store what you find. Prior: v0.9.0 split vault into its own skill for cross-host compatibility.
